change: Publish completed HTTP leases to a preallocated return queue without waiting for pool or ticket-cache locks

regressions: HTTP/1 pool returns a completed response before connection return lock
HTTP/2 pool returns a completed response before connection return lock
unified HTTP pool returns a completed response before connection return lock
before.failure: complete TCP response body was available, but release required one uncancelable pool-lock wait before the response could return
before.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='pool returns a completed response' --summary all
before.fixture: A real server holds the client's pool mutex before writing its first response; the baseline rescue releases that mutex only if client return tries an uncancelable wait.

owning_http3_cases: occupied mutex return retains connection and node for next lease
late close destroys client and retires lease/connection counts once
collector delay preserves original returned connection idle age

ownership.publication: caller transfers owned transport/key/node to atomic queue
ownership.counts: pending returned connections remain in total socket budget
ownership.duplicate_handle_cleanup: inactive release/discard does not republish or destroy transferred storage

close.protocol: atomic closing flag blocks later publishers; close waits only for already admitted atomic publications and then owns all accepted nodes
close.late_return: closed queue leaves node with caller; caller skips TLS close_notify output and retires resources once

queue_tests: publication order and persistent node reuse
128 nodes from four concurrent publishers collected once
256 publications racing close match accepted ownership exactly
after.structure: shared H1/H2 publication and idle-cache logic extracted into pool_returns/authority_returns.zig; concurrent queue, regression fixtures and allocation tests are adjacent cohesive modules

hyper.completed_request: first request completes on a previously acquired lease while pool mutex stays occupied; release publishes before lock is released

http3.transport: TLS 1.3 over QUIC through SOCKS5 UDP ASSOCIATE

references.protocol_principle: completed response ownership is independent of later idle connection caching
